context:
Goal: close the open gaps in the ios-adblock compliance scorecard (your 19:38 CST pick: add the shoot file and a token file).
Problem (goal): the screenshot tool needs a web address and page routes, and ios-adblock has no web pages (the extension has no popup or options page; the iPhone screens are native SwiftUI), so your pick cannot be built as written and you choose how.
Based on (read): bin/shoot lines 61-62 need baseUrl and routes; ios-adblock has no .html, .css or .scss; the iPhone UI is ios/App/AdBlockApp.swift (ios-adblock lane, relayed by the coordinator 19:49 CST; not read by triage).
Based on (ruling): uniform-over-variants (owner, 2026-10-27 12:51 CDT), which rules out teaching the Design check about native repos.
Departs from: main has no shoot file and no token file in ios-adblock — a change adds both, as dead placeholders or as working files from simulator screenshots.
Waiting on: nothing stopped; the lane built nothing and waits for this pick.
